body:
My girlfriend and I did enjoy using MDMA. However, at a party earlier in the year she drank too much water (which wasn't very much!) and as a result, she has permanent brain damage.
Here is the details:
We have both done it several times in the past and are lucky to have a source of pure MDMA.
On the night in question, she did one hit at midnight and another 1/2 at about 2. At about 4 she did the final 1/2 hit, for a total dose of 250 mg over 4 hours.
We were careful to drink water to prevent dehydration. I would guess she drank about one litre, perhaps two before she felt ill. She got a bad headache and felt out of it at about 5. We thought she was dehydrated, so brought her a bottle of water (small) to drink. She sat down, drank the water, and waited for the feeling to pass.
The headache worsed, and she had some more water in attempt to 'rehydrate'
We went home to bed, and awoke at 10:00 in the morning. She was convulsing. We called an ambulance. Long story short - she came within 5 minutes of dying. She was in intensive care for a week. She has permanent brain damage, and can not see the right visual field (as a result of damage to the ocipital cortex of the brain).
We now know the danger of water intoxication (hyponatremia). However I think it is crucial to stress that MDMA contributes to this state. As a result, she did not have to consume vast quantities of water. In fact, her total intake over the evening was likely under 3 litres, and perhaps as little as 2!
So, a word of caution. Be carful, and remember to take salt/electroylytes when doing MDMA.
